paper_title: Are Large Language Models Really Good Logical Reasoners A Comprehensive   Evaluation and Beyond
caption: Visualization on the metric of answer correctness.

annotations.annotation: The 3D bar chart illustrates the accuracy of three models—Davinci-003, ChatGPT, and BARD—across two tasks: Classification and Generation. The horizontal axis contains the categories, with the models' names (Davinci-003, ChatGPT, BARD) arranged in this order, and the tasks (Classification, Generation) displayed perpendicularly. The vertical axis represents accuracy, labeled as "Accuracy," with a linear scale ranging from 0.2 to 0.8, marked at intervals of 0.2. Each category on the axis has a corresponding grouped set of bars representing the two tasks. Davinci-003 shows a bar reaching approximately 0.8 for Classification and about 0.4 for Generation, colored in a gradient of yellow to blue. ChatGPT shows the lowest bars and has a Classification bar at approximately 0.8 and a Generation bar around 0.2, using a similar color gradient, while BARD has the tallest bar, with Classification reaching just about 0.8 and Generation around 0.4. The bars are neither sorted in descending nor alphabetical order, and there are no visual emphases beyond the color gradient applied uniformly across the bars.
